meta.name: create-epic
meta.description: Turn an idea into a structured epic draft using templates/epic-template.md

copy.tagline: 将想法转化为结构化的史诗级草稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把模糊想法整理成清晰的产品需求文档
copy.tagline_en: Turn an idea into a structured epic draft
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn vague ideas into clear product requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将你的产品想法转化为结构化的史诗（Epic）草稿，保存在 epics/ 文件夹中，并标记为“探索”阶段。
howto.when: 当你提供一个简短的产品想法或指向原始想法笔记的文件路径时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个关于统一客户成功经理入职看板的史诗。
say.note: Claude 会读取模板并生成草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude transforms your product idea into a structured epic draft, saved in the epics/ folder with stage set to Explore.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a short product idea or a file path to a raw idea note.

say_en.text: Create an epic about a unified onboarding dashboard for CSMs.
say_en.note: Claude reads the template and generates a draft.

say_en.text: Create an epic from the file samples/sample-epic-idea.md.
say_en.note: Claude reads that file and generates a draft.
